text:
priya.m: Quick sync — who's owning the cascade ramp for the UI rollout today? Need owner, exact percent steps, smoke window, and rollback command. Target start ~ 15:00 PT.

alexg: I'm the release lead. Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% over ~30m intervals. Start at 15:00 PT. Cohorts: 1% internal canary, 5% small geo (US-W), 20% regionally weighted across US, 50% global gradual. Rollback triggers: 95th/99th p90 latency > 300ms OR error rate > 0.5% on any step.

jamal_sre: smoke owner here. I'll run the smoke checks at +5min of each step. Basic smoke checklist:
- health endpoints ok (GET /health)
- no spike in 5m error rate
- KV cache hit rate within expected band
- tail logs for exceptions
Commands to run quickly: 
```
./smoke.sh --service=frontend --cohort=$COHORT
kubectl logs -l app=frontend -n prod --tail=200
rctl metrics query "errors/5m > 0"
```
I'll post brief signal snippets after each step (latency p50/p95, errors, synthetic NPS).

kira_backend: backend note — model variant pinned to `v2-quant` on the canary pool. Quant path gives ~10% perf win; watch hallucination/sanity evals. Feature flag flow: `ff.ui_new_layout` -> rollout states: `off` -> `canary` -> `gradual`. Make sure the flag gate matches cohort hashing.

natalie_pm: product gives 👍 to the staged plan. One request: add a synthetic NPS probe as an additional gating rule. If NPS synthetic drops >2 points for 10m, we want an auto-fail.

jamal_sre: I can add that. New gating policy to include synthetic NPS and latency. I'll add policy snippet to the rollout job before start.

alexg: Rollback play (manual):
```
rctl rollback --service=frontend --to-tag=stable-2026-03-10 --reason="canary-fail"
kubectl rollout status deploy/frontend -n prod
```
Auto-rollback policy will run the above if a gating rule triggers. Manual intervention window: ops can force-rollback within 10m of a failed step. On-call: @jamal_sre @kira_backend @alexg.

devops-bot: Deploy scheduled by alexg at 2026-03-18T15:00:00-07:00. Reminder will fire 5m before start.

priya.m: Thanks — two asks before go: (1) Cap the 5% cohort to 50k unique users to avoid billing spikes, (2) confirm synthetic tests and dashboards are up.

kira_backend: can do on (1) — we'll hash user_id and cap to 50k for the 5% cohort. I'll push the cap to the feature-flag service now.

jamal_sre: (2) dashboards ready. I'll post dashboard links and a short runbook excerpt in the channel 10m before start.

alexg: I'll start the cascade at 15:00 PT. Will announce each step in-thread. If anyone wants to join the smoke call, ping and I'll DM invite. :thumbsup: 

priya.m: Closing loop — owners: alexg (release), jamal_sre (smoke), kira_backend (backend/flags). Start 1768804322 (15:00 PT). Will update the runbook with caps and gating rules.
